reader.requirement: At --std 85, each report group type is presented by the 1985 presentation rules tables (§1985:XIII.3.10): upper and lower limits from the PAGE integers, the body-group fit tests 3a-3c with the saved next group integer, first print line positions 4a-4d, the next group rule 5 and final LINE-COUNTER settings 6a-6f, and none of the limit or fit rules when PAGE is omitted. This is a pointer rule: the witnesses cover region boundaries and unpaged placement, not the saved-next-group arm.

edition-consulted.switches: year < 2002: a report footing's upper limit follows the page footing's 1985 final LINE-COUNTER (Cobol85FinalLineCounter, §1985:XIII.3.10.9 GR5) rather than its last line
Edition.DialectLevel < 2002: a page footing whose first LINE is relative is refused (§1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR9)
DialectBehavior.TerminateDiscardsSavedNextGroup (and the other ReportWriter DialectBehavior arms) per the emitted Edition

reader.edition-search: grep of ReportSectionBinder.cs for DialectLevel/year and ReportWriter.cs for DialectBehaviors.IsActive.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: the 1985 tables have their own arms (PF first LINE absolute, RF limit after a PF's NEXT GROUP, TERMINATE and the saved next group); the shared arms gave the 1985 answer in every probe
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb1270 (every region boundary of a paged report) and pb484 (unpaged placement); fit test 3b with the saved next group integer, first-line rule 4b, and next group rule 5 were not exercised

probes.expected: 1985 body rules: D1 at FIRST DETAIL 3 (4b), 6a -> LC 5; second D1 at 6, 6a -> LC = FOOTING 10, saved 5; D2 fails fit 3b -> page advance, LC = saved 5, presented on LC + 1 = 6 (4b, first paragraph, not 5 + 2), then 6 + 2 = 8

probes.printed: error COBOL2284: integer-1 2 shall lie between the FIRST DETAIL integer 3 and the FOOTING integer 10
probes.expected: refused by next group rule 5; r4ng11.cob (11) the same

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR4  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4

reader.notes: The saved-next-group probe matches the 1985 text exactly, including rule 4b's 'line immediately following' LINE-COUNTER. GroupLimits bounds a report heading by the page heading's first absolute line - 1 instead of 1985's FIRST DETAIL - 1. For a legal program the two refuse the same set, because 1985's PH upper limit follows the RH. Only the diagnosis wording differs.
